PAYLOAD_KEK.description: Random string (32+ chars). Wraps per-event data keys — payload encryption at rest. Escrow it: if lost, encrypted data is unrecoverable.

CONTENT_HMAC_KEY.description: Random string (32+ chars). Signs export links and confirm tokens.

MCP_READ_TOKEN.description: Random string (32+ chars). Read scope — REST reads + the recall MCP connection.

MCP_PROPOSE_TOKEN.description: Random string (32+ chars). Propose scope — capture-plugin ingest + write MCP tools. Must differ from the read token.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Random string (32+ chars). Owner key — apply/discard, exports, purge, manual kicks.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com) — free tier works. Sent through your AI Gateway when AI_GATEWAY_BASE is set.

AI_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible chat API (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Unset = chat runs on Gemini as before.

AI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Bearer key for the compatible provider; falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY. Leave both unset for keyless local endpoints.

AI_MODEL.description: Optional. Chat model name for the compatible provider (e.g. gpt-4.1-mini). Required when AI_BASE_URL is set.

AI_FALLBACK_MODEL.description: Optional. Second model tried when the provider is down, rate-limited, or the model is retired.

AI_EMBED_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Embeddings base URL for a compatible provider. The literal "native" keeps Gemini embeddings while chat runs elsewhere.

AI_EMBED_API_KEY.description: Optional. Bearer key for compatible embeddings; falls back to AI_API_KEY, then GEMINI_API_KEY. Keyless works.

AI_EMBED_MODEL.description: Optional. Embeddings model for the compatible provider (e.g. text-embedding-3-small). Required when embeddings resolve to a compatible provider.

AI_EMBED_DIMS.description: Optional. Embedding size 1-1536 (default 768). Must match your Vectorize index; changing it re-embeds stored facts over the next sweeps.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: (Optional) GitHub token for the activity connector — raises API rate limits.

AI_GATEWAY_BASE.description: Optional. Your AI Gateway endpoint (https://gateway.ai.cloudflare.com/v1/<account_id>/brain/google-ai-studio) — routes Gemini calls through your gateway for analytics/caching. Unset = calls go straight to Google.

BRAIN_DB.description: D1 database: event log and derived memory.

BRAIN_RAW.description: R2 bucket: raw captures, exports and backups.

VECTORIZE.description: Vectorize index for semantic recall (768 dims, cosine).
